name: toc
title: Table of contents
description: An on-this-page list of links to the headings of the current page, with the heading being read highlighted.
a11y: A nav landmark with an aria-label (default "On this page") containing a list of links.
The heading being read has aria-current=location; it is tracked with an IntersectionObserver, not scroll handlers.
Links are real anchors: Tab reaches each one, Enter follows it, and the URL hash updates.
Links are plain anchors, so scrolling follows the browser and the page's own motion settings.
Focus uses the shared ring; the current link is also marked with a bar and heavier weight, not colour alone; works in forced-colors.

props.name: items
props.description: The entries, in page order. Use this or `container`.

props.name: container
props.description: Build the entries from the headings (that have an id) inside this element; rescanned when it changes. Used when `items` is not set.

props.name: levels
props.description: Heading levels to pick up from `container`. Default [2, 3].

props.name: heading
props.description: Visible title above the list. Pass `null` to hide it. Default "On this page".

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name of the navigation landmark. Default is the heading, or "On this page".

props.name: offset
props.description: Pixels from the top of the viewport where a heading becomes the current one; match your sticky header. Default 96.
